### When and where is IAA Transportation 2026?

IAA Transportation 2026 runs from September 15 to September 20, 2026, in Hanover, Germany, with a press day on September 14. It is the world's leading trade fair for commercial vehicles and logistics technology. Tesla's participation puts it alongside the major European truck manufacturers on their home turf — a deliberate statement of intent.

### Has Tesla been building toward this for a while? [...] If you run freight operations in Europe, mid-September is the moment to pay close attention. The IAA reveal will almost certainly include the information needed to begin a serious procurement evaluation: pricing, range figures under European load
